cases.sentence: Из ___ вышел борец по имени Голиаф из Гата.
cases.explain: «филистимского лагеря» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.

cases.sentence: На голове у него был ___, а сам он был одет в бронзовую кольчугу весом в пять тысяч шекелей .
cases.explain: «бронзовый шлем» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.

cases.sentence: На ногах у него были ___, а за спиной висел бронзовый дротик.
cases.explain: «бронзовые наколенники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He had bronze shin armor on his legs, and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.

cases.sentence: На ногах у него были бронзовые наколенники, а за спиной висел ___.
cases.explain: «бронзовый дротик» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He had bronze shin armor on his legs, and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.

cases.sentence: Древко его копья было большое, как ткацкий навой, а ___ весил шестьсот шекелей .
cases.explain: «железный наконечник» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron. His shield bearer went before him.

cases.sentence: Три старших сына Иессея пошли за Саулом на войну: первенца звали Елиав, ___ — Авинадав, а третьего — Шамма.
cases.explain: «второго сына» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone after Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

cases.sentence: Рано утром Давид оставил стадо ___, взял ношу и отправился в путь, как велел Иессей.
cases.explain: «другому пастуху» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took and went, as Jesse had commanded him. He came to the place of the wagons, as the army which was going out to the fight shouted for the battle.

cases.sentence: Он добрался до лагеря, когда войско с ___ выходило на свои места.
cases.explain: «боевым кличем» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took and went, as Jesse had commanded him. He came to the place of the wagons, as the army which was going out to the fight shouted for the battle.

cases.sentence: Давид оставил свою ношу ___ и побежал в ряды, поприветствовать братьев.
cases.explain: «обозному сторожу» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage, and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.

cases.sentence: Когда он говорил с ними, Голиаф, ___, выступил из рядов и прокричал свой обычный вызов на бой, и Давид услышал его.
cases.explain: «филистимский воин» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: As he talked with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and said the same words; and David heard them.

cases.sentence: Когда он говорил с ними, Голиаф, филистимский воин, выступил из рядов и прокричал свой ___ на бой, и Давид услышал его.
cases.explain: «обычный вызов» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: As he talked with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and said the same words; and David heard them.

cases.sentence: Увидев этого человека, израильтяне убегали от него в ___.
cases.explain: «великом страхе» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: All the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were terrified.

cases.sentence: Когда Елиав, ___ Давида, услышал, как тот говорит с людьми, он разгневался на него и спросил:
cases.explain: «старший брат» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger burned against David, and he said, “Why have you come down? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride, and the naughtiness of your heart; for you have come down that you might see the battle.”

cases.sentence: Саул одел Давида в свои ___.
cases.explain: «собственные доспехи» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.

cases.sentence: Он надел на него кольчугу и возложил ему на голову ___.
cases.explain: «бронзовый шлем» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.

cases.sentence: Взяв в руку посох, он выбрал себе в ручье пять ___, положил их в свою пастушью сумку и с пращей в руке приблизился к филистимлянину.
cases.explain: «гладких камней» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He took his staff in his hand, and chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag which he had. His sling was in his hand; and he came near to the Philistine.

cases.sentence: − Иди сюда, − сказал он, − и я отдам твою плоть ___ и земным зверям!
cases.explain: «небесным птицам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The Philistine said to David, “Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky, and to the animals of the field.”

cases.sentence: − Иди сюда, − сказал он, − и я отдам твою плоть небесным птицам и ___!
cases.explain: «земным зверям» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The Philistine said to David, “Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky, and to the animals of the field.”

cases.sentence: Сегодня я отдам трупы филистимского войска ___ и земным зверям, и весь мир узнает, что есть Бог в Израиле!
cases.explain: «небесным птицам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Today, Yahweh will deliver you into my hand. I will strike you, and take your head from off you. I will give the dead bodies of the army of the Philistines today to the birds of the sky, and to the wild animals of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,

cases.sentence: Сегодня я отдам трупы филистимского войска небесным птицам и ___, и весь мир узнает, что есть Бог в Израиле!
cases.explain: «земным зверям» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Today, Yahweh will deliver you into my hand. I will strike you, and take your head from off you. I will give the dead bodies of the army of the Philistines today to the birds of the sky, and to the wild animals of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,

cases.sentence: Тела убитых филистимлян были разбросаны вдоль ___, которая вела в Гат и Экрон.
cases.explain: «шаараимской дороги» — after the preposition «вдоль», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.
